verdict.rationale: Trivy can scan whole directories/filesystems/images/repos in a single CLI invocation (probe-6) and supports k8s cluster-wide scanning (trivy-gh-1), which is a form of bulk operation across many items (files, packages, images). However, there's no evidence of an AI-native bulk-operation interface (e.g., batch API, scan-many-targets-at-once command, or MCP tool for bulk querying across many items) — the MCP server (probe-7) supports natural-language single queries, not documented bulk/batch operations across many items via the AI interface. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or MCP tool for operating on many targets at once, evidence of programmatic multi-target orchestration beyond single scans, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale automation workflows.
